newsitem.title: ITALY: Omnitel wants connection charge cut 75 pct.
newsitem.headline: Omnitel wants connection charge cut 75 pct.

text.p: Italian mobile phone consortium Omnitel is asking for a reduction in connection charges of 75 percent to 50 lire from 200 lire per minute when the mobile phones are connected to the national telecoms network.
Omnitel's managing director Silvio Scaglia told a transport commission of the lower house of parliament that the charge in Italy was very high in comparison with other major European countries.
Omnitel, in which Olivetti has around a 35 percent stake, is Italy's second mobile phone group which operates in competition with the state-controlled Telecom Italia Mobile (TIM).
